questions.stem: The working principle and design of Feistel Structure used in cryptographic algorithm for creating the
options: b. Increase in Size of Cipher
questions.explanation: Feistel structure is designed to build cryptographic complexity via rounds.

questions.stem: The DES (Data Encryption Standard) cipher follows the fiestal structure. Which of the following properties are not shown by the fiestal structure?
options: a. The input text is divided into two parts: one being left half and another one being right half.
b. Swapping of the left and right halves are performed after each round.
c. The plain text is converted into a matrix form first
questions.explanation: Feistel does not require converting plaintext into a matrix first.
